title: Hard to figure out
text: Hard to figure out. Ok...let me preface it took 3 grown adult women to figure out how to use this thing.  It looks simple enough but I didn't find that it was just that easy to figure out how to use the darn thing.  It did the job but like other reviewers I still had to cut off the first part of the banana.  However, it does save me 1/2 banana as my son and I only eat 1/2 banana at a time.  The other down side is that you have to have knife with you since you have to cut the banana perfectly for it to fit.  No ripping a banana off.  This was inconvenient for me as I wanted to have this for the diaper bag when we were to give him a banana at meal time or as a snack.  Overall, it does save the banana but it's not as convenient as I thought it would be.
